method: Bounded reconciliation of previously thin secondary fields using the maintained exact-name Super Soul catalogue plus corroborating repository-linked documentation. Canonical records remain authoritative; unsupported timers and stack caps were not inferred.

changes.notes: Recorded no reported stacking rule and Auto Just Guard Limit Burst effect.

evidence_boundaries: No numeric duration was invented where the catalogue does not document one.
No numeric stack cap was invented.
Acquisition, reward probability, and unrelated mechanics were not changed.
validation_target: 234 canonical / 0 duplicate IDs / refreshed strict-thin census
